prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080, drawn as a FULL-BLEED EDGE-TO-EDGE illustration.

FRAMING - READ THIS FIRST, THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT INSTRUCTION: There is NO page border, and there must be NO empty white margin strip around the scene. The previous attempt at this scene FAILED because it left wide empty white space on all four sides with the whole scene floating small in the middle - DO NOT DO THAT AGAIN. Instead, draw every object MUCH BIGGER than you think you should, zoomed in so close that the square canvas physically CUTS OFF parts of the scene on every side: the sun must be cropped by the top edge (only the lower two-thirds of the sun and its rays visible, top rays running off-canvas), the mosquito net and grass must run off the entire bottom edge with no gap, the hanging shirt must be cropped by the left edge, and the repellent bottle must be cropped by the right edge. The virus character's body must be enormous, nearly touching the top of the frame with its head and overlapping the mosquito net at the bottom. Leave NO more than a few small pockets of white between objects - fill at least 97% of the square edge-to-edge with linework touching or crossing all four borders. Do NOT draw a rectangle, a double rule, a thin outer line, a box, or a panel edge anywhere.

SCENE: A friendly round ZIKA VIRUS character fills most of the frame, sitting happily in a sunny daytime garden. It is a smooth, perfectly round, chunky ball - its entire rim and body are covered edge-to-edge with a neat pattern of small flat interlocking chevron/diamond panels drawn as plain closed outlines directly on its round body (like the seams of a football or a woven basket), so a child can colour each little panel a different colour. CRITICAL: the ball's own outline must stay ONE perfectly smooth, continuous, round curve all the way around - the panel pattern is only surface linework, NOTHING pokes out, sticks up, or projects from the ball anywhere: no spikes, no studs, no bumps, no points, no zigzag edge on the silhouette itself. The virus has a BIG FRIENDLY FACE: two large round eyes with pupils, cheerful curved eyebrows and a warm gentle smile, plus two little stubby arms, one of them waving hello.
Around it, cropped by the canvas edges as described above: a big round SUN with simple closed rounded rays (each ray a fat rounded triangle directly touching the sun's own body, like a classic child's-drawing sun - NOT thin radiating lines) is tucked in the top corner, partly cut off by the top edge; a coiled-up MOSQUITO NET with a friendly simple diamond-grid pattern fills the lower part of the picture, running off the bottom, left and right edges with no white gap beneath it; a chunky bottle of MOSQUITO REPELLENT with a friendly smiling face and a big round spray nozzle stands to one side, cropped by the right edge, with a couple of simple closed spray-drop shapes near its nozzle (small solid rounded droplets, not radiating spray lines); a cosy LONG-SLEEVED SHIRT with buttons hangs on a simple wooden hanger, cropped by the left edge, sleeves clearly long down to the cuffs; and a small, round, FRIENDLY CARTOON MOSQUITO character (chunky rounded body, two simple wings, a short blunt closed-loop proboscis, big round friendly eyes, no menacing expression) hovers just above the virus's head, close to the top edge. Everything is drawn large, simple and chunky so a child can colour inside every shape. Do NOT draw any human child, any skin, any rash, any bite mark, any pregnant belly, or any medical/needle imagery anywhere in the scene.

GROUND LINE: any grass or ground texture at the very bottom must be drawn ONLY as a simple wavy or jagged OUTLINE (a thin single or double contour line suggesting grass tips), exactly like every other line on the page - it must stay an open colourable outline shape. NEVER fill the grass, or any other area, solid black.

STYLE - coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere on the entire page, including the ground/grass (eyes may have a small solid pupil only - that is the ONLY place solid black is allowed).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with generous white space INSIDE each individual shape (but not as a margin around the whole scene).
- Playful, warm and reassuring - nothing gruesome, no distressed or unhappy faces anywhere, no needles being administered, no sick, itchy or bitten imagery of any kind.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN - the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, double rule, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box or vignette anywhere near the edges of the square. NO frame of any kind.
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, thin sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, motion lines, glow rings, glow arcs, or halo of rays behind, around or under the character, the sun, the repellent bottle, or anywhere else. The sun's rays must be drawn as short, fat, CLOSED rounded/triangular shapes directly attached to its round body, never as thin open radiating lines. This includes short curved open "glow" arc-lines beside any object - those count as radiating decoration too and are forbidden. NO open/unclosed decorative arc or ray lines of any kind anywhere on the page - every line must belong to a real, closed, colourable object. The virus's surface panels must stay flat, closed, and clearly part of the smooth round body so the character never reads as a burst, a star, or a spiky creature.
- ANY wide empty white margin or gutter running along a whole edge of the square with no linework crossing it. This is the single most common failure - check every edge before finishing.
- ANY solid black filled area anywhere on the page (except small pupils). This includes solid black grass, solid black shadows, or any solid black shape.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks anywhere.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO human figures, no skin, no rash, no bite marks, no medical needles, no pregnant belly drawn on any character.
- NO spikes, studs, bumps or points projecting from the virus character's round silhouette anywhere - its outline must stay one smooth continuous curve.
